subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

A poem of lamentation on the death of someone loved and admired.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Elegy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Elegy"** means a poem of lamentation, typically mourning the death of someone loved and admired. (शोक गीत)

 
 
• **Example:** The poet wrote an elegy to mourn the passing of his beloved friend.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Elegy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Soliloquy** (स्वगत): A speech in which a character speaks their thoughts aloud, often when alone.

 
 
• **Example:** Hamlet’s soliloquy "To be or not to be" is one of the most famous passages in literature.
 
 
 
• **Tragedy** (त्रासदी): A form of drama based on human suffering that invokes an accompanying catharsis or pleasure in audiences.
 
 
• **Example:** Shakespeare's "Romeo and Juliet" is a classic example of a tragedy.
 
 
 
• **Epitaph** (समाधि लेख): A brief statement written on a tomb or gravestone, often in memory of the deceased.
 
 
• **Example:** The epitaph on her gravestone reads, "Beloved mother and wife."
